title: Orsen and the Static
author: Lior Thornbury
blurb: Coral Thornbury, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
